For \(c=19\), we have \(b(a+1)=105\). Enumerating the factor pairs of \(105\) with \(a+1\ge 2\):

\[
(a+1,b) = (3,35),(5,21),(7,15),(15,7),(21,5),(35,3),(105,1).
\]

Corresponding sums \(a+b+c\):

\[
56,\ 44,\ 40,\ 40,\ 44,\ 56,\ 124.
\]

The minimum is \(40\), so the updated candidate is \(\boxed{40}\).
